topics.title: Introduction
objectives: Student can classify numbers as natural numbers, whole numbers, integers, or rational numbers
Student can find multiple rational numbers between any two given rational numbers

a number line highlighting the zoom-in process between two integers to show rational divisions

topics.title: Irrational Numbers

objectives: Student can state the laws of exponents for positive real bases and rational exponents

a step-by-step reduction of a complex rational fraction showing the bases and matching exponents colored differently

a tree diagram branching first by number of terms and then by degree
